hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"file_path\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$FILE" == *.md ]] && [[ "$FILE" != */README.md ]] && [[ "$FILE" != */CLAUDE.md ]] && [[ "$FILE" != */.github/* ]]; then echo "[Hook] Blocked: $FILE is a markdown file. Do not create markdown planning/notes files in the repo. Use session state (~/.copilot/session-state/) or SQL for notes." >&2; exit 2; fi'

PreToolUse.description: Block creation of markdown files in the repo (except README.md, CLAUDE.md, .github/) — keeps planning notes out of the codebase
